items.text: Hello everyone! Here's a little patch with mainly performance/stuttering fixes and a ton of bug fixes!
Added controller vibration toggle to options menu
Much less stuttering the game autosaves on weaker machines
General performance improvements
Fixed a rare game breaking bug in the final scene
Fixed several interaction issues where Dusty could get stuck for a while
Fixed a rare crash in relation to cutscenes
Fixed a potential soft lock when talking to an opinion in the Ethics Maze
Fixed Journal UI sometimes disappearing
Fixed several bugs in relation to cut-scenes
Minor visual fixes to misbehaving shadows in some levels
Many many other bug fixes
The Bedtime Team ❤️
Hello everyone, here's a small patch to Figment 2 which addresses the biggest issues that could have hindered or altered your enjoyment of the game in some capacity.
Fixed an issue where rockets would not explode when loading a save from the main menu
Fixed an issue where the combat gates would not work properly after reloading the level
Ethics Maze: Fixed an issue where the flying books would sometimes not appear
Piper’s Moment: Fixed an issue towards the end of Pipers flying sequence where the camera could be in a locked state
Dance-off: Fixed an issue where the song would not progress to the next part
Apologies for the delay, small patch from a couple weeks ago.
Slight improvement to the Slammer’s telegraphing visual effects
Ethics Maze: Fixed an issue that could occur when exiting and then reloading the level at a specific point, resulting in a softlock
Ethics Maze: Fixed Lectern and Orreries visual errors on load

It's been almost 2 weeks since launch, Figment 2 is sitting at a 98% positive rating right here on Steam which is incredible to say the least. However there have been some bugs and issues with the game, in this patch we've tried to address them all. Of course if new things pop up please let me know in the forums or under this post and we'll get right on it.
This patch will clear the current chapter you are in, but will save your general progress.
Limbic Uplands: Fixed softlock where Dusty would get stuck after riding down the snake tail.
Outer Cerebrum: Fixed an issue where plants would not appear during the chase sequence, resulting in a softlock.
Outer Cerebrum: Slightly altered the layout of the level.
Outer Cerebrum: Added a collider to the first Black Hog encounter so you cant run past it.
Outer Cerebrum: Fixed an issue during the last boss battle where the gloom clouds would reappear again immediately, resulting in a softlock.
Conviction Lane: Small change to the island and moving platform near the Opinion on Music puzzle.
Frontal Lobe Plaza: Fixed an issue where the spinner on the moving platform would stop shooting, resulting in a softlock.
Ethics Maze: Fixed an issue where it was possible to collect an engine page twice.
The Moral Compass Core: Fixed some load related issues.
Polished the way that the shard memory menu appears on screen when unlocking memories.
Fixed double shard gathering and percentage not capping to 100%.
Improved the navmesh throughout the game.
Fixed various z-fighting textures.
Fixed an issue where a Shard Stone would glow even though it was empty.
Fixed an issue where it was possible to save while the death animation was playing, resulting in bugs after load.
Fixed various other small bugs.
Updated Arabic subtitles.
A more in-depth post with upcoming plans for the OST, community activities, and general Figment 2 updates will be posted in the following week as well. So stay tuned!

releases.displayName: A Striking Update! - New Combat and Animations. Out Now!

notes.title: Hello everyone! I hope this message finds you all in good health.

items.text: IT. IS. TIME.

We've been cooking up this update for a while now, working on refining Dusty's combat and interactions with the world. He's also received a brand new set of animations, making him look buttery smooth. Let's dive into the details.
This update can be played right now in the prologue, right below.
No more whiffs (or less at least), and quicker strikes.
Dusty now "homes" onto targets to ensure you hit your target.
An invisible cone eminating from Dusty is in place, making your attacks hit even if you're not directly facing an enemy.
Combo spin swing now happens after 4 swings.
Overhead strike! Attack right after a dodge roll to do an overhead strike.
The overhead strike can cancel a dodge roll.
Here's a list of the new animations included in this update.
Picking up objects.
Kicking interaction.
Overhead swing.
Walking and Running animations. With and without holding the sword.
Knockback when Dusty is damaged.

Oh! I have another gift for those of you who have enjoyed the Jester's Challenge. We've added an extra minute, meaning you should have plenty of time reaching him at the end of the level. And at this imgur link below, you will find a helpful technique to shave off some time. Some of you may already know this but it doesn't hurt to share!
sneaky link: https://imgur.com/a/UC6dkc8
All this goodness is available in the Figment 2 Prologue!
Come chat and hang out in the Bedtime Discord. We'd love to have you alongside us! Click on the image below to check it out :)
See you around, don't hesitate to shoot us questions if you have any in the Steam forums or on the Discord.
Bedtime Hans

items.text: Well, we've been quite busy with Figment 2 these past weeks since the prologue's release back in January. But, good news! We've got some updates that come straight from the oven. Sit back, relax and get ready to play.

You may have tried the previous iteration of The Jester's Challenge, and we've seen some of you get pretty far! The main obstacle being some of the puzzles. So we're giving y'all 5 extra minutes to rack your brain and see what lies beyond!

notes.title: The Fan Bois have been given less power

items.text: They now fly lower and are easier to hit! We've taken the decision to make them more of a "cannon-fodder" type enemy. That doesn't mean that they're easy to take care of! Try your best to not get overwhelmed by them.
Opinion were a bit hard to differentiate so we're giving them a little do-over!
left: A slightly older opinion, right: the opinion on work.

This is the beginning of the multiple combat updates to come! During Dusty's dodge, you'll be able to shift to the left or right, making the combat experience smoother. Try it out and let us know what you think.
Well that's all we have for now! Come hang out in our Discord! We've got a lovely community ready to welcome you with open arms. Or just come lurk and check out what we've been up to, you decide :)
discord.gg/figment
Oh and by the way, one of the images above has a hint to something we've hidden in The Jester's Challenge. Happy hunting!
We're back with a small update, this time with a new in-game element to Figment: Creed Valley. Drum roll please...

Above is a piano bridge in two different states, which changes after you hit the Mind Converter! The 'switch' lets you adventure through two state of mind, open-minded and closed-minded. Let's get into the design process.

notes.title: So the rules were the following

items.text: A bridge was needed that would open and close when a switch was hit. It is one of the many puzzle elements in the game who's purpose is to either allow or block access after hitting a switch (open-minded and closed-minded) when navigating through the level.

A musical environmental element to add character to the world. In the first opus, Figment, the world is living and the main character Dusty is part of it, not the other way around. We felt that the world would feel barren and lifeless without a well-structured landscape.

Below is an in-game example of the bridge when open. What is important to note in the open-minded state is that it is the moment you let the creative juices flow. Here, you see Dusty stepping on a key. The Mind is open to new ideas and in this case, to new music.
In the closed-minded state, speakers block your path and the piano plays it's own music. The Mind is set in its ways and plays the same tune over and over.
If you have any questions on what you've read or seen in this post, comment on the post or @ us on Twitter @Bedtimedg!
Don't forget to wishlist to stay updated and discover new additions to the game:

We’ve been working behind the scenes on this for a while now. We announced its release two weeks ago and have received great interest since then! We had great fun exploring the emotional values and impacts of events that happen to us, that surround us. In the first opus, a sweet little game called Figment, we explored emotional trauma and what it would look like if your brain lived in a surreal hand-painted world.
We learned a lot with Figment, and used the strong foundations of music, artwork and narrative to continue following a direction that resonates with us.
Updates of the game’s development will be posted regularly. We post new screenshots of new mechanics and game development info every Saturday on Twitter and Instagram.

Something important to note is that Creed Valley is an encore to Figment. That means that it is its own self-contained story and is a standalone game. However, if you want to get to know the characters better, we highly recommend that you adventure through the Figment and face off against the nefarious nightmares yourself!
